title:
Epic that checks the {@link Sensor#isMonitored} value and sets the
`updatesEnabled` field in the `Reliability.ChangeSensorMonitorSettingsModalForm` form
according to this field.

The epic handles three logical cases: no sensors, multiple sensors, single sensor (main branch).
1. When no sensors are selected or no sensors are found in the state
    - returns an empty observable
2. When multiple sensors are selected
    - returns a inputChangeAction that sets the toggle to false
3. When one sensor is selected
    - returns a inputChangeAction that sets the toggle to the value of isMonitored
name: UiSdlEpicChangeToggleFieldSensorMonitorSettings
